messages.subject: ERROR: Error sourcing /srv/connect/apps/myapp.R
parts: I'm new to this and have been trying to upload my first testing app but keep seeing this error. My app runs find locally on my computer. Does anyone know what might be the problem? Thanks heaps!

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: ERROR: Error sourcing /srv/connect/apps/myapp.R
parts:
My guess is that you are including myapp.R with a relative path of "../myapp.R", as your application, when deployed, is served out of a directory named "/srv/connect/apps/<application name>".
All files used by your application should be within the same directory structure that is deployed to shinyapps.io
